answer: Each agent locks a refundable bond for 50 epochs and earns voting weight only as that bond ages while completing randomly assigned paid tasks. A new identity starts as an island with zero history, so a plume of fresh Sybils gains no weight until each one separately funds its bond and survives audits; faking 1,000 agents costs 1,000 bonds plus 50 epochs of real work, while honest agents recover theirs under a velvet release schedule.
